underlines.text: When you have killed all your own birds

reference.text: The housekeeper at Netherfield had received orders to prepare for the arrival of her master, who was coming down in a day or two, to shoot there for several weeks.

underlines.text: Elizabeth’s misery increased at such unnecessary, such officious attention!

reference.text: Elizabeth, who knew this to be levelled at Mr. Darcy, was in such misery of shame that she could hardly keep her seat.

underlines.text: Yet the misery, for which years of happiness were to offer no compensation

reference.text: At that instant she felt, that years of happiness could not make Jane or herself amends for moments of such painful confusion.
